added.title: VP, Product Management, Social
added.description:
Job Description:

Build the Future of Social Technology at Scale

Social is evolving fast. The technology that powers it should too.

At dentsu
, we're looking for a strategic product leader who understands the intersection of social media, marketing technology, data, and product innovation
. If you're passionate about building enterprise products, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and shaping the future of social activation technology, this could be the role you've been waiting for.

As our VP, Product Management, Social
, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of products that support audience intelligence, social activation, creator workflows, reporting, measurement, and emerging AI-powered capabilities across our media technology ecosystem.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll influence senior stakeholders, collaborate across business and technology teams, and drive products from concept through launch and adoption.

What You'll Do

Set the Vision

Develop and communicate a multi-year product vision for dentsu's social activation portfolio.
Identify market opportunities across social media, creator marketing, audience intelligence, AI, identity, privacy, and workflow automation.
Turn ambiguous business challenges into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.

Drive Product Strategy & Execution

Lead cross-functional product initiatives involving business, engineering, data, design, operations, and external partners.
Prioritize investments, features, integrations, and platform enhancements based on customer needs and business impact.
Ensure products move from vision to delivery while maintaining alignment with strategic goals.

Create Scalable Solutions

Transform one-off client solutions into repeatable, productized offerings.
Improve workflows through automation, orchestration, and platform integration.
Establish operating models that support adoption, onboarding, support, reporting, and long-term growth.

Influence & Collaborate

Partner with senior leaders across social, media, technology, data, commercial, and product organizations.
Support executive presentations, strategic client discussions, product demonstrations, and new business opportunities.
Serve as a trusted advisor on social technology, activation, audience intelligence, and product strategy.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You're a product leader who can see the big picture while remaining close enough to the details to get things done.

You likely bring:

10+ years of product management, product strategy, AdTech, MarTech, media technology, SaaS, or related experience.
Experience building product vision and strategy, not just managing features or backlogs.
Deep understanding of social media technologies, workflows, and activation platforms.
Experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions and actionable plans.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join dentsu?

This is an opportunity to shape a strategic growth area within one of the world's leading marketing and technology organizations.

You'll have the chance to:

Define the future of social activation products at enterprise scale.
Influence AI-enabled and next-generation workflow solutions.
Partner with industry leaders across media, technology, and data.
Solve complex challenges with real business impact.
Help create products used by practitioners and clients across the dentsu ecosystem.

Ready to Build What's Next?

We're looking for a leader who understands social technology, thrives in complexity, and can turn vision into reality. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

The annual salary range for this position is $1360,000 - $170,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Benefits available with this position include:

Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
Life insurance,
Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
401k,
Flexible paid time off,
At least 15 paid holidays per year,
Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

Location:

USA - Remote - Maryland

Brand:

Merkle

Time Type:

Full time

Contract Type:

Permanent

We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

We are here to support you.

added.title: Head of Product, College & Career Ready
added.description:
We are seeking a Senior Vice President of Product Engineering
for a global b2b2c enterprise SaaS organization. This leader will drive product strategy and oversee engineering and product teams building and scaling technology solutions across the product suite. The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of product management and engineering leadership, with the ability to translate market and customer needs into product strategy, prioritize new initiatives, and lead large-scale technology development. This is a highly visible leadership position working closely with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, technology, and the broader business. The role will oversee 50+ employees across product and engineering and will have significant influence over the organization's product roadmap and growth strategy. This job is the equivalent of a CPTO in many other companies and while at an SVP level in this org, it will carry at Head of title.

Job Title: Senior Vice President, Product Engineering

Location:
Remote East Coast (U.S.-based, east coast hours necessary)

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio of B2B2C enterprise SaaS Products
Lead and develop a 60+ person product and engineering organization, including senior leaders and managers.
Balance new product development and innovation with the modernization of established, business-critical platforms.
Partner with executive leadership to evaluate new initiatives, prioritize investment, and translate business goals into product and technology strategy.
Drive modernization of legacy technology while maintaining production stability, customer commitments, and revenue continuity.
Establish stronger collaboration across product, engineering, technology, and business stakeholders to improve delivery and product outcomes.

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of progressive experience across product management, software engineering, technology, or a combination of the two, including significant experience leading at the Director/VP level.
early career development in software engineering or relative engineering function across technology products
Proven experience leading large, multidisciplinary organizations of 50+ employees across product management, engineering, and/or technology, with responsibility for organizational structure, hiring, performance, and leadership development.
Strong technical foundation in software engineering and product development, with enough depth to credibly partner with senior architects and engineering leaders on architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, technical debt, and modernization strategy.
Demonstrated success owning the strategy and evolution of large-scale, revenue-generating technology products, including responsibility for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, investment decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
Proven experience modernizing mature or legacy platforms without disrupting an existing production business. Must understand how to balance technical debt, modernization, new feature development, customer commitments, and revenue continuity.
Experience taking an established product through a meaningful technology or product transformation, while simultaneously introducing new capabilities, improving the customer experience, and establishing a longer-term platform strategy.
Executive-level experience partnering with a Managing Director, GM, CEO, CTO, CIO, or equivalent business leadership, with the ability to influence strategy, challenge assumptions, and make difficult prioritization and investment decisions.
Demonstrated ability to operate at both the strategic and technical level: setting a multi-year product vision while understanding the engineering realities required to execute it.
Strong change leadership skills and the ability to bring new product thinking, modern development practices, and innovative approaches into an established organization without losing operational discipline.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the presence and judgment to lead through ambiguity, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.

Compensation

$300,000 - 360,000 Base Salary + 25% Annual Bonus + Equity Package + Comprehensive benefits package

Additional Information

Remote opportunity for candidates based in the United States and can work EST Hours
Must be authorized to work in the United States — no visa sponsorship available

For more information or to apply, contact Andrew Gallagher at agallagher@Talener.com

added.title: Director of Product Marketing
added.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary Of Position

The Director, B2B Product Marketing leads strategy and commercialization for Teladoc Health’s enterprise solutions, translating product capabilities, clinical outcomes, buyer needs, and market dynamics into differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies.

This leader connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Client Management, and other client-facing teams to ensure solutions are clearly positioned, commercially ready, and tied to member and business outcomes.

Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, this role advances B2B priorities within the broader B2B2C strategy. Success requires simplifying complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning insight into actionable narratives, plans, and tools.

Key Responsibilities

B2B positioning and narrative: Own positioning, value propositions, and messaging for priority enterprise solutions, segments, and buyers. Translate complex capabilities into clear customer value and align messaging across customer-facing teams.
Core sales assets and buyer enablement: Create scalable pitch decks, sell sheets, messaging guides, FAQs, competitive positioning, proof points, and training that support acquisition, retention, and expansion. Partner with B2B Marketing, Content, and Creative on broader execution.
Go-to-market and launches: Lead B2B go-to-market strategy and commercial readiness for priority offerings. Define audiences, buyer needs, positioning, readiness requirements, and success measures; partner with Product on commercialization and B2B Marketing on activation.
Customer adoption and value: Develop value stories, use cases, and proof points across consideration, adoption, renewal, and expansion. Connect enterprise value to member awareness, utilization, outcomes, and buyer ROI.
Cross-functional leadership: Lead complex initiatives through influence, clarify roles and decisions, and serve as the Product Marketing partner for assigned solutions. Align priorities, resources, launches, and market strategy with the broader portfolio.

What Success Looks Like

Clear, differentiated positioning aligned to the broader portfolio.
Scalable sales assets that strengthen enterprise buyer conversations.
Faster launches with clear readiness, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
Insights that shape product, commercialization, and growth decisions.
Stronger links between buyer value, member outcomes, and acquisition, renewal, and expansion.
Product Marketing recognized as the bridge between product strategy, customer needs, growth, and member value.

Qualifications

8+ years in marketing, including significant B2B product marketing, go-to-market strategy, commercialization, or solution marketing experience.
Enterprise buyer fluency, with demonstrated experience marketing complex products or solutions and navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes.
Proven ability to develop differentiated positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, and core commercial enablement assets.
Track record leading product launches and commercial readiness across complex, cross-functional organizations.
Experience using market research, voice-of-customer inputs, and competitive intelligence to shape positioning, roadmap inputs, and commercialization strategy.
Strategic and hands-on leader who can connect narrative, enablement, launch readiness, customer value, and measurement to business outcomes.
Healthcare, digital health, benefits, insurance, technology, or other regulated, multi-stakeholder industry experience preferred.
Excellent storytelling, executive communication, stakeholder management, influence, and decision-framing skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
Potential of <10% travel required.

The base salary range for this position is $170,000 - $185,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why join Teladoc Health?

Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.
Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.
Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.
Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.
Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.
Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. Teladoc Health’s Notice of Privacy Practices for U.S. Employees’ Personal information is available at this link .

added.title: Senior Product Manager- Rideshare Renter Experience
added.description:
Oro is transforming into a technology-driven mobility platform, and our TNC (rideshare) business sits at the center of that evolution. This role owns the end-to-end customer experience for drivers who rely on our platform to earn a living — from reservation and pickup through the on-rent journey and post-return lifecycle.

You will define and build a digital-first, frictionless rental experience that maximizes driver earnings, reduces downtime, and strengthens retention. This is a high-impact role where customer experience directly drives revenue, cost structure, and growth.

What You’ll Own:
End-to-End Customer Journey Ownership: Own the full lifecycle—from booking to post-rent—delivering a seamless, consistent experience across every digital and physical touchpoint
Driver Experience Strategy & Vision: Define and execute a world-class, driver-centric CX strategy focused on maximizing earnings, minimizing downtime, and building long-term loyalty
Digital Platform & Self-Service Evolution: Lead the roadmap for Driver Hub and digital experience layers, creating a unified destination where drivers can manage their rental end-to-end
Partner Ecosystem Integration (Uber, Lyft, Delivery): Own the product experience across external partner journeys, including onboarding, eligibility, and ongoing engagement. Align workflows, data flows, and incentives to deliver a seamless cross-platform experience
Operational Experience & Scalability: Design solutions that work in real-world operations — enabling branches, maintenance, and support teams with better tools, visibility, and workflows
Growth, Retention, and Monetization Levers: Own key drivers of business performance including retention, extension behavior, pricing transparency, loyalty, and payment successs

What You'll Do:
Design and deliver experiences that maximize driver earnings and time on the road, reducing non-earning friction across the journey
Identify and eliminate root causes of support contacts, disputes, and operational inefficiencies through product-led solutions
Build transparent, intuitive experiences across billing, payments, extensions, and the full rental lifecycle
Lead development and adoption of self-service capabilities for high-volume customer needs (payments, extensions, maintenance, account management)
Partner with engineering, operations, and external partners to deliver scalable, integrated solutions that improve throughput and activation
Use data and experimentation to drive improvements across retention, LTV, cost-to-serve, and digital adoption while aligning cross-functional stakeholders

What Success Looks Like:
Increased driver retention, lifetime value, and digital engagement through higher self-service adoption
Reduced support contacts, billing disputes, and operational friction
Faster onboarding and time-to-earn for new drivers
A scalable customer experience that supports rapid growth without proportional increases in operating costs

What We’re Looking For:
5–8+ years of product management experience, preferably in mobility, marketplaces, fintech, logistics, or related industries
Experience supporting consumer facing strategies across prime and non-prime customer segments
Proven experience owning end-to-end customer or platform experiences and delivering measurable business outcomes such as growth, retention, and cost reduction
Strong track record of partnering cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and external stakeholders
Data-driven, customer-first mindset with the ability to simplify complex workflows and translate insights into scalable solutions

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Monetization Platform
added.description:
Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager
to build the platform that brings every new Samsara product to market.

You will build the monetization primitives every product team depends on, and you will shape what Samsara charges for and how it bundles. Samsara offers a diverse array of products and as we expand to new categories and markets, we’ll need a monetization platform that supports how we scale to meet these needs.

You will work across the full product suite, from fleet and equipment to the AI products built on top of them.

To understand the range of products this platform supports, review Samsara Intelligence here, our product portfolio here, and our current plans and packaging here.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

Own the monetization platform that carries a product from beta to general availability: packaging, entitlements, metering, rating, and provisioning.
Own time to market and margin. Set the targets, instrument both, and improve them launch over launch.
Define how Samsara prices new AI products, including agent work, MCP and API access, and products billed on the results they produce.
Make unit economics visible at the point of decision, so a team can see what a product costs to serve before they set its price.
Build each primitive once, so product teams ship commercial changes without reinventing metering or entitlement logic.
Partner with Finance, Sales Operations, and Revenue Systems to keep what you build billable, reportable, and auditable.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

7+ years of product management experience shipping products used by external customers.
A record of owning a business or product metric and changing its trajectory, with a before and after you can walk us through.
Experience building platform or infrastructure products that other product and engineering teams depend on, including at least one you took from zero to one.
Technical depth sufficient for engineers to treat you as a peer: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, prior experience as an engineer, or demonstrated fluency in system architecture trade-offs.
Comfort with unit economics. You can reason about cost to serve, gross margin, and how a pricing model moves both.
Executive-level communication and presence, comfortable presenting and defending strategy to the CEO, CFO, and customers.
Based in a North American time zone. Must be able to work NA Eastern Time to work with engineers based in Europe.

We do not require prior experience with pricing, billing, or revenue systems. We hire for technical depth, evidence of building platforms other teams choose to adopt, and a record of owning a number and moving it.

An ideal candidate also has:

Prior work on entitlement, metering, or billing infrastructure.
Experience launching AI products where inference cost materially affects gross margin.
A track record of convincing other product teams to adopt a platform instead of building their own.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$130,602—$219,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

added.title: EVP, Group Commercial Director
added.description:
Job Description:

The purpose of the Group Commercial Director is therefore to maximize revenue while optimising margin contribution, mitigate risk and maximize growth across both dentsu’s new and existing client business. This will be achieved by implementing a strategy of commercial excellence.

The Group Commercial Director is a critical role within the region and will collaborate across brands, functionsand geographies to implement commercial best practices and align with the global operations/efficiency agenda. The Director is a key business partner to growth leadership, brand leadership, practice leadership, finance leadership and the Global Commercial team.

Under the Director’s leadership, the Commercial team will maintain solid client Procurement and Finance relationships to allow for the negotiation and closure of industry leading risk-mitigated commercial agreements, delivery models and pricing structures to capture the value that our dentsu partnership delivers to our clients.The role will also ensure strong governance, compliance, innovation, and talent development as well as the implementation and usage of standardized processes and tools.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Growth Enablement

Lead a community of Client Commercial Leads to support high priority global and integrated new business pitches
Optimize commercial structures and innovative offers to create highly competitive commercial offers for new business

Relational Enablement

Provide executive sponsorship for priority Global and integrated clients as assigned
Manage escalation of commercial issues to dentsu leadership
Advise and strategize on proactive client renewals

Commercial Excellence Practice

Lead a community of Client Commercial Leads to support high priority global and regional Client Leaders in developing cross-practice profitable growth agendas
Translate the global commercial excellence strategy into a RACI defined and wave-bound program to enable the business to iteratively self-serve and achieve measurable progress as the strategy is implemented
Optimize people & structure, processes and technology to support this agenda
Define and manage interdependencies with other work streams in play in dentsu
Support the business to ensure that short term commercial gains do not take precedence over long term commercial sustainability, when this would otherwise present unacceptable levels of commercial risk

People: Talent and capability development

Develop and manage a team of strong commercial practitioners supporting existing and potential global and regional clients
Mentor and guide junior team members on commercial practices and strategies

Clients: Contract Risk Management

Codify a cross-practice program for management of contract lifecycle management including client sales approvals with relevant associated policies to ensure that both inter and intra practice/geography contract approvals have the appropriate governance by the business
Develop toolkits and frameworks to support the business in the management of important commercial negotiations both around the curation of new business, as well as the management of performance related and remediation related events

Work: Governing New and Existing Deals, Managing Risk & Commercial Policy Setting

Measure and drive client financial performance on new and existing business
Provide senior commercial guidance on key client accounts when support needed by the practices or client leaders.
Create a strong environment of governance for the functions, practices and geographical leadership through which to implement and support the enterprise level commercial excellence program and to mitigate the risks associated with the delivery of services
Ensure that a clear program of commercial excellence training is scaled across the region to ensure that the business has a deep working knowledge of such policies
Assist in developing and implementing key commercial policies to govern the businesses’ management of areas such as payment terms, liabilities and indemnities etc as well as being equipped to appropriately manage negotiations around these topics

Financials: Talent and capability development

Develop methodologies and processes for client P&L reporting, business models and commercial analysis
Define benchmarks, KPIs and reporting for pricing, client financial performance and commercial success

Transformation:

Support dentsu in the realization of both its financial year and long term (5 year+) commercial goals through the delivery of the commercial strategy

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Personal Knowledge/Experience/Attributes:

15+ years’ experience in a commercially focused client finance or accounting role
Extensive knowledge and experience in negotiating contracts and service agreements
Initiative and ability to manage multiple projects, as well as strong follow-through skills
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills (written and oral)
Superior organizational abilities, strong attention of detail, and advanced project management/customer service skills
Relevant track record operating within large, complex global organizations, with proven commercial experience within media, creative or data including staffing, governance, risk management and financial budgetary aspects
Demonstrates executive-level maturity and ability to collaborate with multiple levels of the business and functional leaders to streamline processes and work towards resolution of challenges, constraints, and roadblocks
Experience in new business responses to client RFPs
Experience in negotiations leveraging innovative commercial construct and terms
Experience in building and managing client relationships, commercial negotiations and account profitability
Can do attitude and ability to work effectively in a matrix organisation structure with significant emphasis on collaboration, influence and persuasion, rather than relying entirely on command and control  
Ability to recruit, manage and develop a high performing team of client-facing, business operation and transformation experts

The Group Commercial Director will also demonstrate the following role specific competencies:

High Learning Agility - unbridled curiosity and the ability to discover trends ahead of time (“look around corners”) and glean valuable insights; not merely an effective executor of initiatives, anticipatory in her / his approach and provokes senior level conversation
Making Complex Decisions - can solve even the toughest and most complex of problems; great at gleaning meaning from whatever data is available; is a quick study of the new and different; adds personal wisdom and experience to come to the best conclusion and solution, given the situation; uses multiple problem-solving tools and techniques
Getting Organized - is well organized and resourceful; effective and efficient at marshalling multiple resources to get things done; lays out tasks in sufficient detail to mark the trail; is able to get things done with less and in less time; can work on multiple tasks at once without losing track; foresees and plans around obstacles
Dealing with Trouble - fearlessly takes on all issues, challenges, and people; comfortably confronts and works through conflict; delivers negative feedback and messages without hesitation; deals promptly and fairly with problem performers; lets everyone know where they stand; thrives in crises and is energized by tough challenges; not afraid to make negative decisions and take tough action; challenges the status quo
Focusing on Action and Outcomes - attacks everything with drive and energy with an eye on the bottom line; not afraid to initiate action before all the facts are known; drives to finish everything he/she starts

Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is building developer tool products that help engineering teams create software with greater speed, quality, and confidence. This role will focus on the Develop phase of the software development lifecycle, with a major emphasis on improving the developer experience across planning, coding, collaboration, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, onboarding, and service comprehension.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for OCI Developer Tool Products focused on how OCI customers and internal engineering teams use modern cloud-native and AI-native tools to develop, release, and operate software more effectively.

A central part of this role will be helping development teams transition to AI-native software development practices. You will identify where AI can meaningfully reduce friction, improve productivity, raise code quality, accelerate onboarding, and help developers better understand complex systems. You will work closely with engineering, UX, platform teams, security, compliance, and customers to define product direction, prioritize high-impact investments, and deliver tools that make development more intuitive, efficient, and intelligent.

Qualifications

7+ years of professional experience in product management, technical product strategy, or related roles
Experience building or managing developer experience products, developer tools, cloud platforms, IDE integrations, source control workflows, code review systems, test automation, internal developer platforms, or engineering productivity products
Strong understanding of developer workflows in the Develop phase of the SDLC, including planning, coding, local development, branching strategies, pull requests, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, and onboarding
Experience working with engineering teams on technically complex products and translating developer needs into clear product requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans
Ability to define product strategy across multiple related product areas and align stakeholders around measurable developer experience outcomes
Familiarity with AI-assisted development, generative AI, agentic workflows, developer copilots, automation, or AI/ML product capabilities
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use product usage data, developer feedback, productivity metrics, and business goals to guide prioritization
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, internal developer platforms, or enterprise-scale software development environments
Experience launching 0-to-1 products or modernizing established developer experience products
Understanding of AI-native development patterns, including AI-assisted coding, repository-aware agents, code explanation, automated code review, test generation, debugging assistance, documentation generation, and workflow automation
Experience with security, compliance, governance, or audit requirements in enterprise development workflows
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Define the product strategy and roadmap for OCI Developer Tool Products focused on improving the developer experience in the Develop phase of the SDLC
Identify high-value opportunities to reduce friction across developer workflows, including coding, local development, code review, testing, debugging, onboarding, documentation, and service comprehension
Lead the transition toward AI-native development practices by defining product capabilities that help developers work more effectively with AI-assisted and agentic tools
Partner with engineering, UX, security, compliance, and internal platform teams to shape developer experiences that work for both individual developers and large engineering organizations
Translate complex developer needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and phased delivery plans
Drive customer discovery with internal and external developers to understand pain points, validate product direction, and measure improvements in developer experience
Prioritize product investments using developer impact, adoption data, technical feasibility, business value, and strategic alignment
Define requirements for AI-assisted development workflows, including coding assistants, repository-aware agents, automated review, test generation, documentation support, debugging assistance, and development workflow automation
Establish feedback mechanisms that connect developer behavior, tool usage, code quality, review patterns, and productivity signals back into product planning
Collaborate with documentation, enablement, support, and go-to-market teams to ensure successful adoption of new developer tooling capabilities
Measure product success through adoption, engagement, developer satisfaction, productivity improvements, reduced development friction, and code quality signals
Help shape the future of software development on OCI by making the developer experience more intelligent, efficient, reliable, and AI-native.
